question: footway geojson
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 10

question: wkt longest tertiary road
sql: SELECT ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt, names.primary AS name FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary' ORDER BY ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:32629',always_xy:=true)) DESC LIMIT 1

question: service road start end lon lat rounded
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)),5) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)),5) AS start_lat, ROUND(ST_X(ST_EndPoint(geometry)),5) AS end_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_EndPoint(geometry)),5) AS end_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' LIMIT 5

question: residential 30kmh name speed label
sql: SELECT CONCAT(names.primary, ' - ', CAST(speed_limits[1].max_speed.value AS VARCHAR), ' km/h') AS label FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND speed_limits[1].max_speed.value = 30 AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

question: secondary road lengths km rounded
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:32629',always_xy:=true))/1000.0,2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' ORDER BY length_km DESC LIMIT 10

question: sidewalk geojson with name
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson, names.primary AS name FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk' AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10
